purpose: Collect a small prospective first-party PRE-only sensor from official public Keirin sources to challenge the staged KDreams-derived Digital Twin realism envelope without using outcomes or further same-source tuning.

selection.event_scope: Japanese Keirin first-party official public PRE pages/files only
selection.ordering: scheduled_start_jst ascending, then venue_code/name ascending, then race_number ascending
admit_only_if: official first-party source identity is established
race-level PRE fields are directly available without inference
no authentication, CAPTCHA/WAF bypass, rate-limit evasion, or restricted-access workaround is required

target_fields.forbidden_inference: Do not infer any missing field from rider identity, prior result, third-party page, odds, payout, or post-race information.

planned_checks: race-band/class/style/score/tactical marginal distance when directly available
multivariate dependence distance when sample size is sufficient
locked discriminator evaluation using the already-defined feature families without generator retuning

interpretation.success_means: The official prospective PRE sensor is compatible with one or more pre-existing Twin worlds within measured fields.
interpretation.failure_means: The pre-existing Twin worlds are falsified or incomplete on measured PRE dimensions and require a new preregistered revision after the sensor receipt is frozen.

next_step: Discover only first-party official prospective PRE sources inside the locked window and write append-only capture receipts.
